name: The Heart of Hakkar
label: Quest
description: The Heart of Hakkar: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within. Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, the reek of an evil soul surrounds you. Have you been cursed by the Soulflayer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the Heart of Hakkar. So the Soulflayer has been slain! Our world is saved!
Friend, your service to us cannot be overstated. You truly are a hero of this realm!
